svg.aria-label: Sharur, an output style for Claude Code. Against Concise on Opus 5.5, everyday coding tasks cost 21% less and their replies have 54% fewer words to read; large tasks cost 10% less and a huge one 6% less, 12% across the three sizes, with the same hidden tests passed. Asked to add a multiply function with a test, it replied in 37 words, where Concise wrote 89.

text.tspan: 54% fewer words to read, same tests passed.
